indicator: observer inside target reports no WEA receipt while other channels show sent
minimum_evidence_demand: inside observer packet, carrier/device, CAP geometry, ACK/error, provider delivery logs
claim_cap_effect: cap WEA delivery and public-receipt claims

indicator: outside-control device receives WEA
minimum_evidence_demand: outside observer packet, target polygon, device location uncertainty, provider sector map if available

indicator: boundary observers disagree on receipt
minimum_evidence_demand: GPS/generalized location, polygon version, device geolocation setting, timestamp drift check
claim_cap_effect: hold until polygon and observer location reconciled

indicator: one carrier misses while others receive
minimum_evidence_demand: carrier split report, device classes, provider log request, counterevidence path

indicator: older 4G/3G-compatible device fails to show alert
minimum_evidence_demand: device capability/setting proof, WEA setting screenshot, carrier support matrix

indicator: device default language does not match alert language/template
minimum_evidence_demand: template packet, language settings, FCC multilingual template applicability, local translation review

indicator: alert received outside protective-action decision window
minimum_evidence_demand: timestamp chain across PAD/PAR, CAP, ACK, carrier, device receipt

indicator: device shows original after correction/cancel issued
minimum_evidence_demand: CAP update/cancel chain, archive state, device screenshot sequence

indicator: alert link unreachable or stale
minimum_evidence_demand: link-health checks, public web logs, cached copies, correction timestamp

indicator: screen reader/caption/ASL/plain-language support absent or unusable
minimum_evidence_demand: accessibility test packet, user setting, alternate channel proof

indicator: call center/social reports show action confusion despite receipt
minimum_evidence_demand: call log issue categories, correction log, rumor-control packet

indicator: school/LTC/hospital does not acknowledge action message
minimum_evidence_demand: institution log, protective-action start/end, parent/family message evidence

indicator: farmer/producer channels conflict with public KI/evacuation/hold messages
minimum_evidence_demand: agriculture bulletin, call log, correction packet

indicator: public archive search does not find expected message
minimum_evidence_demand: query parameters, lag window, CAP ID, archive limitation ledger
claim_cap_effect: do not infer no alert from no-hit

indicator: multiple flattened records look like multiple alerts
minimum_evidence_demand: dedup/supersession key, CAP identifier, update/cancel chain
claim_cap_effect: do not count duplicates as corroboration

indicator: screenshot lacks device/time/content/custody hash
minimum_evidence_demand: original file hash, EXIF/capture log if available, observer attestation

indicator: preliminary finding quoted as delivery success
minimum_evidence_demand: meeting transcript hash, final AAR clock, evaluator finding linkage

condition: false reassurance from high receipt sample
indicator: sample receipt high but no AFN/language/rural coverage
minimum_evidence_demand: sampling frame, demographic/device/carrier mix, gap analysis

indicator: correction issued after protective-action window
minimum_evidence_demand: rumor discovery time, correction approval/release time, channel reach

indicator: multiple independent no-receipt or confusion reports with custody
minimum_evidence_demand: counterevidence bundle, adjudication board, CAP/retest link
